::: {#lem-slr-mean-dot-product}
#### The conditional mean is a dot product

In simple linear regression (@def-slr),
the conditional mean of observation $i$ is the dot product
of its covariate vector (@def-slr-covariate-vector)
and the coefficient vector $\vcoef$ (@exm-normal-equations-slr):

$$\mean(x_i) = \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}.$$
:::

::: proof
This is the solution to @exr-slr-mean-dot-product.
:::
